from collections import deque
def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]; res=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if g[i][j] and not seen[i][j]:
                c=g[i][j]; q=deque([(i,j)]); cell=[]
                while q:
                    a,b=q.popleft()
                    if (a,b) in cell: continue
                    cell.append((a,b)); seen[a][b]=True
                    for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        n=(a+da,b+db)
                        if 0<=n[0]<H and 0<=n[1]<W and g[n[0]][n[1]]==c and not seen[n[0]][n[1]]: q.append(n)
                rs=[a for a,_ in cell]; cs=[b for _,b in cell]
                h=max(rs)-min(rs)+1; w=max(cs)-min(cs)+1
                box=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
                for a,b in cell: box[a-min(rs)][b-min(cs)]=c
                # transpose
                out=[[box[b][a] for a in range(w)] for b in range(h)]
                res.append(out)
    return res

                    for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):

                box=[[0]*mc for _ in range(mr)]
